text:
Rebecca: Quick thread  SI Accelerator + Marketplace launch next month. We need a minimal, audit-friendly handoff token and a lightweight dispute path.
Jonas: Agreed. Suggest a `claim_badge` enum: `si_primary`, `si_assist`, `redwood`. Badge determines routing and reporting.
Tori: How is badge assigned? automation from utm/portal/email + manual claim by partner ops. Also add TTL: a claim expires after 14 days of inactivity.
Ben L.: Add shadow_owner metadata so the original AE remains visible and CAN veto for named accounts. Veto flow: AE sets `veto=true` -> partners ops notified -> 24h review window.
Gina: For marketplace leads: if utm_source contains partner sku AND partner clicked "claim" in intake portal within 48h -> assign `si_primary`. Else still Redwood.
Rebecca: For SI intros: require partner intro email OR portal referral + scheduled meeting within 10d. If missing, badge not granted.
Jonas: Dispute ladder: 1) file `claim:dispute` (creates thread in #partnerships-disputes), 2) 24h SLA for initial response, 3) unresolved -> weekly ops arbitration meeting. partnerships-bot should capture all messages and set `dispute_state`.
partnerships-bot: automation note will post new claim events to #partnerships-disputes, set CRM fields `claim_badge`, `shadow_owner`, `dispute_state`, and emit `lead_claimed` webhook. :robot_face:
Tori: Engineering asks: intake API fields: `claim_badge` (string), `partner_claimed_by` (string), `claim_reason` (string), `claim_expires_at` (timestamp). Also webhook on badge changes.
Ben L.: UI request: small banner in lead view with badge, assigned owner, shadow owner, and one-click "appeal" -> files dispute.
Gina: Named accounts = manual review only. If account.named=true, do NOT auto-grant badge.
Rebecca: OK locking this set. I'll write the short playbook and sample email template for intro tagging. Pilot these rules for the launch. Any objections?
Jonas: None from eng.
Tori: All good.
Ben L.: No objections.
Gina: Locked. I'll prep partner docs. Rebecca: ping when playbook is up.
Rebecca: Will do 389 Thanks everyone.
